findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: export_agent · Private data: timestamp_receipt, provision_workspace, top_up_workspace, record_action, record_usage · Public sink: timestamp_receipt, top_up_workspace · Destructive: export_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: export_agent · Private data: timestamp_receipt, provision_workspace, top_up_workspace, record_action, record_usage · Public sink: timestamp_receipt, top_up_workspace · Destructive: export_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "timestamp_receipt" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
